signing_certificate_sha256_origin: Verified unchanged signing certificate for 1.0.3, 1.0.4 and 1.0.5 CI; 1.0.6 requires pinned same SHA256
continuity_guarantee: Same independent application ID and signing certificate as 1.0.5, preserving per-device V3/V7 native launcher preferences and local crew meeting data across update. Builds fail if cached original signer is missing. V3/V7 installed apps and their stored reports remain untouched.
recovery_requirements: Captain-controlled private encrypted signing-keystore backup required before treating as durable release. Never embed keystore, P12, password or seed in app.
